rows.label: qst650690_msg0001
rows.name: What did you want to show me, Tora?

rows.label: qst650690_msg0002
rows.name: Moffuffu!

rows.label: qst650690_msg0003
rows.name:
Tora just remembered finding
something amazing, mo!

rows.label: qst650690_msg0004
rows.name: More junk, I bet.

rows.label: qst650690_msg0005
rows.name:
H-how rude, mo!
Just wait here while Tora gets it, mo!

rows.label: qst650690_msg0006
rows.name: Oh, brother...

rows.label: qst650690_msg0007
rows.name:
Look, Boss, mo!
Behold this brilliance!

rows.label: qst650690_msg0008
rows.name: Th-this is[ML:Dash ]!

rows.label: qst650690_msg0009
rows.name: What?

rows.label: qst650690_msg0010
rows.name:
W-wrong one, mo!
This is from Tora's
top-secret collection, mo.

rows.label: qst650690_msg0011
rows.name: Now, once again...

rows.label: qst650690_msg0012
rows.name:
Look, Boss, mo!
Behold this brilliance!

rows.label: qst650690_msg0013
rows.name: Th-this is[ML:Dash ]!

rows.label: qst650690_msg0014
rows.name: Could it be a Core Crystal?!

rows.label: qst650690_msg0015
rows.name: That's right, mo!

rows.label: qst650690_msg0016
rows.name:
Tora happened to get it after
learning he had no Driver aptitude,
and then completely forgot, mo.

rows.label: qst650690_msg0017
rows.name:
But someone with high Driver aptitude,
like you, Boss,
should be able to resonate, mo!

rows.label: qst650690_msg0018
rows.name: I can feel tremendous power[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650690_msg0019
rows.name: But that's not all.

rows.label: qst650690_msg0020
rows.name:
I can feel something like
kindness and warmth, too.

rows.label: qst650690_msg0021
rows.name:
Then try resonating with it
right away, mo!
